p.src: 1  The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

en: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
u.src: 1  The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

p.src: 2  When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

ja: らおうと襲いかかったとき、 私の敵対者と敵は、つまずき、
en: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
u.src: 2  When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

p.src: 3  Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

ja: こっても、 それでも私は確信を失わない。
en: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
u.src: 3  Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

p.src: 4  One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

en: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
u.src: 4  One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

p.src: 5  For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

ja: 身の天幕に私をひそかに守られるからだ。 その
en: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
u.src: 5  For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

p.src: 6  Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

げられる。 私はその
びのいけにえをささげる。 私は
う。まことに、主にほめ歌を歌う。
en: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
u.src: 6  Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

p.src: 7  Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

ja: いてください。 私をあわれみ、
en: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
u.src: 7  Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

p.src: 8  When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

en: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
u.src: 8  When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

p.src: 9  Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

ja: ってあなたのしもべを
けないでください。 あなたは私の

en: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
u.src: 9  Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

p.src: 10  When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
u.src: 10  When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

p.src: 11  Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

ja: のゆえに、私をまっすぐな小
en: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
u.src: 11  Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

p.src: 12  Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

ja: 対する者たちの意のままに引き
かい、 残酷なことを吐き出しているからだ。
en: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

p.src: 13  I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

ja: 私はなお、このことを確信している。
en: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
u.src: 13  I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

p.src: 14  Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

ja: を奮い立たせよ。 そうだ、
en: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
